definitions.gloss: monetary easing; monetary relaxation; quantitative easing
definitions.explanation: A central bank policy of lowering interest rates or increasing the money supply to stimulate economic activity. A key term in economic news and policy discussions in Japan.

examples.japanese: ⟦{日銀|にちぎん}→日銀：19311_nichigin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{金融緩和|きんゆうかんわ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{決定|けってい}した→決定する：21022_ketteisuru⟧。
examples.english: The Bank of Japan decided on monetary easing.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大規模|だいきぼ}→大規模：12185_daikibo⟧な{金融緩和|きんゆうかんわ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{景気|けいき}→景気：02694_keiki⟧⟦{回復|かいふく}→回復：03812_kaifuku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{後押|あとお}し→後押し：12509_atooshi⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Large-scale monetary easing helped push economic recovery forward.

examples.japanese: ⟦{長引|ながび}く→長引く：14473_nagabiku⟧{金融緩和|きんゆうかんわ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{副作用|ふくさよう}→副作用：05015_fukusayou⟧⟦について→〜について：03103_nitsuite⟧⟦{専門家|せんもんか}→専門家：03088_senmonka⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{間|あいだ}→間：00914_aida⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{議論|ぎろん}→議論：02650_giron⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}いている→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧。
examples.english: Debate continues among experts about the side effects of prolonged monetary easing.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{金融|きんゆう}→金融：02664_kinyuu⟧ ('finance; monetary') and ⟦{緩和|かんわ}→緩和：13846_kanwa⟧ ('easing; relaxation'). A central concept in Japanese economic reporting, particularly since the Bank of Japan's aggressive easing policies beginning in the 2010s.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{大規模|だいきぼ}→大規模：12185_daikibo⟧{金融緩和|きんゆうかんわ}: large-scale monetary easing
- {量的|りょうてき}{金融緩和|きんゆうかんわ}: quantitative easing (QE)
- {金融緩和|きんゆうかんわ}⟦{政策|せいさく}→政策：10070_seisaku⟧: monetary easing policy
- {金融緩和|きんゆうかんわ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{解除|かいじょ}する→解除する：26843_kaijosuru⟧: to end monetary easing
- {異次元|いじげん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{金融緩和|きんゆうかんわ}: unprecedented monetary easing (coined for BOJ's 2013 policy)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{金融引き締|きんゆうひきし}め→金融引き締め：26659_kinyuuhikishime⟧: monetary tightening — the opposite policy of raising rates or reducing money supply
- ⟦{利下|りさ}げ→利下げ：15819_risage⟧: rate cut — a specific tool within monetary easing
- {量的緩和|りょうてきかんわ}: quantitative easing — a specific type of monetary easing focused on expanding the money supply
